title: gaitrec-rehab: early gait biomechanics, later rehabilitation stays, and the reliability of visit-to-visit change
description: Reliable longitudinal gait monitoring across four lower-extremity injury groups, on the open GaitRec dataset (1,667 rehabilitation patients). Visit-to-visit changes in force-plate measurements were about twice as variable as same-day noise predicts; a threshold adding visit-to-visit variation was calibrated in held-out patients and in each of four injury groups, with an analysis of the declines it misses. A prediction study with a frozen internal protocol found early gait did not predict a later rehabilitation stay (AUROC difference -0.009, 95% interval -0.057 to 0.073). Statistical calibration only; not clinically validated. Code, tests, independent re-implementation, frozen protocol, results and technical report.
